title: OPD：反向 KL 在线蒸馏账（teacher 切片校验 + 右移 datum 组装 + step 批账 + IDT 交替调度）
title_en: OPD: Reverse-KL On-Policy Distillation Accounting (Teacher Slice Validation + Right-Shift Datum Assembly + Step Batch Ledger + IDT Interleaved Scheduling)
source_lines: 01-demo-sync.py completion_teacher_logprobs + build_opd_datum + 主循环内核；05-interleaved-multi-teacher-opd.py build_task_schedule + resolve_total_steps + count_scheduled_steps + batch_for_task_step
description: OPD 的核心主张：蒸馏不必让学生拟合教师的前向分布（forward KL / JSD），而是学生先自主采样、教师对学生实际采出的轨迹逐 token 打 logprob，reverse KL = student_logprob − teacher_logprob——学生比教师更偏好的 token 被惩罚、更不偏好的被奖励，−reverse_kl 直接当 advantage 走 importance_sampling 更新（无价值网、无奖励模型、无组基线）。官方 agentic-rl-lab 的确定性账（PyTRIO/datasets/swanlab 剥除，rollout 与 teacher 打分全入参），四入口复刻：teacher_logprobs——compute_logprobs 返回整段 all_ids 的逐 token logprob，completion 区间从 len(prompt_ids) 切到结尾，随后长度必须恰好等于 len(completion_ids) 且区间内无 None，任一违反 ValueError（长度失配经切片落入同一校验、不 IndexError）；datum——右移账，prompt_loss_len = len(prompt_ids)−1，input = prompt + completion[:-1]（最后一个 input 位预测 completion 末 token），target = [0]×prompt_loss_len + completion（prompt 区间 0 占位、从最后 prompt token 位开始预测 completion），logprobs/advantages 前段 0.0 占位（prompt 内部不是 OPD 训练目标），四序列等长否则 ValueError，dtype 官方 target int64 / 其余 float32；step——批账，空序列跳过不产 datum，reverse_kl = np.asarray(student_lps) − np.asarray(teacher_lps) 逐 token 向量差，advantages = −kl_penalty_coef × reverse_kl，reverse_kls 逐 token extend（统计是 token 粒度非序列粒度），datums 全空 RuntimeError，metrics = mean/std（np 默认 ddof=0）；schedule（05-interleaved IDT 调度）——build 拼 ("medical",)×m + ("ceval",)×c 固定周期，resolve 的 steps=0 时按两类数据 ceil(size/batch) 步数取 max 周期数乘回周期长度（保证两类都至少遍历一次），count 用 schedule[step % len] 逐 step 计数，batch 用任务自己的 step 下标回绕取批 rows[(task_step×batch_size + offset) % len(rows)]（两类数据互不跳步）。
description_en: OPD's core claim: distillation need not make the student fit the teacher's forward distribution (forward KL / JSD) — the student samples on-policy first, the teacher scores the student's actual rollouts token by token, and reverse KL = student_logprob − teacher_logprob: tokens the student prefers more than the teacher get penalized, less-preferred ones get rewarded, and −reverse_kl serves directly as the advantage for an importance_sampling update (no value net, no reward model, no group baseline). This problem replicates the deterministic accounting of agentic-rl-lab (PyTRIO/datasets/swanlab stripped, rollouts and teacher scoring fully parameterized) via four solve entries: teacher_logprobs — compute_logprobs returns per-token logprobs for the whole all_ids sequence, the completion region is sliced from len(prompt_ids) to the end, then the length must equal len(completion_ids) exactly and contain no None, either violation raising ValueError (length mismatch falls into the same check via the slice, never IndexError); datum — the right-shift accounting: prompt_loss_len = len(prompt_ids)−1, input = prompt + completion[:-1] (the last input position predicts the final completion token), target = [0]×prompt_loss_len + completion (prompt region zero-padded, completion predicted starting at the last prompt position), logprobs/advantages zero-padded up front (prompt tokens are not OPD training targets), all four sequences equal length or ValueError, official dtypes int64 for targets and float32 otherwise; step — the batch ledger: empty sequences are skipped without producing a datum, reverse_kl = np.asarray(student_lps) − np.asarray(teacher_lps) as a per-token vector difference, advantages = −kl_penalty_coef × reverse_kl, reverse_kls extended per token (statistics are token-granular, not sequence-granular), all-empty rollouts raise RuntimeError, metrics = mean/std (np default ddof=0); schedule (the IDT scheduling from 05-interleaved) — build concatenates ("medical",)×m + ("ceval",)×c into a fixed cycle, resolve with steps=0 computes each task's ceil(size/batch) steps, takes the max number of cycles, and multiplies back by the cycle length (guaranteeing both datasets are traversed at least once), count tallies schedule[step % len] per step, batch wraps rows[(task_step×batch_size + offset) % len(rows)] using each task's own step index (the two datasets never skip each other's steps).
notes: 官方账的关键细节（沙箱实测钉死）：(1) teacher 切片校验的双重性——长度失配走「切片后 len 不符」落入同一 ValueError，不产生 IndexError；(2) 右移账的不对称——input 吃 completion[:-1]、target 吃完整 completion，长度契约都是 len(prompt)−1+len(completion)，右移偏移错一位变异由 target 的 [0]×4+completion 精确钉死；(3) float32 dtype 是 PyTRIO schema 契约（logprobs/advantages float32、target int64），期望值含 float32 噪声（−0.60000002384…），测试用 round(·,6) 对齐；(4) step 账的统计粒度——reverse_kls 逐 token extend，mean/std 是全批 token 粒度，空序列跳过不产 datum 也不产统计；(5) 空 datums 是 RuntimeError 不是 ValueError（官方「没有可训练数据」与「数据形状非法」是两类错）；(6) IDT 调度的三处回绕——schedule[step % len] 选任务、rows[(start+offset) % len(rows)] 取批、resolve 的 max-周期数乘回，count 在 7 步 2:1 周期下 m5/c2（第 7 步回绕到 medical）；(7) batch_for_task_step 用**任务自己的 step 下标**（medical step 0 与 ceval step 0 都从各自 rows[0] 起步），两类数据互不跳步——与全局 step 索引取批的变异可区分。与 to-gkd-jsd-loss（JSD 正向、teacher 前向分布）与 to-kl-controller（RLHF KL 惩罚项进 pg loss）双向划界：OPD 的 KL 是 student−teacher 的逐 token logprob 差、直接当 advantage，无参考策略采样、无 PPO clip。
notes_en: Key official details (pinned by sandbox runs): (1) the dual nature of the teacher slice check — length mismatch falls into the same ValueError via the post-slice length comparison, never IndexError; (2) the asymmetry of the right-shift ledger — input takes completion[:-1] while target takes the full completion, both of contract length len(prompt)−1+len(completion); off-by-one shift mutants are pinned by the exact [0]×4+completion target; (3) the float32 dtype is the PyTRIO schema contract (logprobs/advantages float32, targets int64) and expectations carry float32 noise (−0.60000002384…); tests compare via round(·,6); (4) the step ledger's statistics granularity — reverse_kls is extended per token, so mean/std cover the whole batch at token granularity, and skipped empty sequences produce neither datums nor statistics; (5) empty datums raise RuntimeError, not ValueError (the official code distinguishes 'no trainable data' from 'malformed data'); (6) three wrap-arounds in the IDT schedule — schedule[step % len] picks the task, rows[(start+offset) % len(rows)] picks the batch, and resolve multiplies the max cycle count back; count yields m5/c2 for 7 steps of a 2:1 cycle (step 7 wraps to medical); (7) batch_for_task_step uses **each task's own step index** (medical step 0 and ceval step 0 both start at their own rows[0]) so the two datasets never skip each other — distinguishable from a global-step-index mutant. Boundary vs to-gkd-jsd-loss (JSD forward, teacher's forward distribution) and to-kl-controller (RLHF KL penalty inside the pg loss): OPD's KL is the per-token logprob difference student−teacher used directly as the advantage — no reference-policy sampling, no PPO clipping.
